ISRO successfully launches first imaging satellite EOS-05 into geostationary orbit

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully launched its first imaging satellite, EOS-05, into geostationary orbit. The satellite, launched via the GSLV-F17 rocket, is designed to provide continuous surveillance of Earth from an altitude of 36,000 kilometers. Officials stated the satellite will enhance national security by monitoring China and Pakistan borders and will also be crucial for disaster management and early warning systems. ISRO chief confirmed the satellite is functioning perfectly. The launch has been hailed as a significant achievement reflecting India's growing capabilities in space technology.
